controls.label: gofmt
controls.note: Inherent to the toolchain. Almost always already clean; costs nothing to enforce.

controls.label: go vet
controls.note: Ships with the toolchain and has an extremely low false-positive rate. Enforce immediately.

controls.label: golangci-lint
controls.note: Config ships with a narrow linter set and new-code-only mode enabled, so a legacy repo is gated on new commits without a backlog rewrite.

controls.label: go test
controls.note: Add -race in CI. Locally it roughly doubles runtime, which is enough friction that people stop running tests.

controls.label: coverage floor
controls.check: go test -coverprofile=/tmp/office-cover.out ./... && go tool cover -func=/tmp/office-cover.out | tail -1
controls.note: Record the current total in harness.md and ratchet as a tracked task.

controls.label: import boundary test
controls.note: An architecture fitness function. This is the control most repos lack and most need: it makes module boundaries enforceable rather than aspirational.
